items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: We became great friends. ... And he became a great friend and I’ve known him until the day he died.

ctx.x: Well how is music and medicine intertwined for you in your life?

Oh different ways. People — one small example of medicine and music would be Herman Chittison, the piano player, happens to be about my age. I had heard him many years ago when he was a Blue Note pianist on a program called the — some kind of photography — Flash Casey, Crime Photographer. It was from the radio, on Thursday nights. And the setting was in a place called the Blue Note. And every week it was a whodunnit thing. It was kind of interesting. But in the background music was this guy playing the piano. And…
